info.title: FluentCRM API
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for FluentCRM — a self-hosted email marketing and CRM plugin for WordPress.

post.description:
Download the archived per-recipient emails of a campaign as a CSV.

This is a **POST-only attachment endpoint**: submit it as a form (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) including a `_wpnonce` REST nonce. The server verifies the nonce, then streams the file and ends the request, so use it from a browser form or download link, not as a JSON API. <Badge type="warning" text="Pro" />

<!-- fc:access -->

**Required capability:** `fcrm_manage_contacts_export`

_Enforced by `ExportPolicy::verifyRequest()`, the policy default for this route group._

**Requires:** FluentCampaign Pro. Without it the route does not exist.

<!-- /fc:access -->

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign whose archived emails are exported.

filter_type.description: Optional filter applied to the exported emails (read by the exporter; empty exports all).

_wpnonce.description: A `wp_rest` nonce (`wp_create_nonce('wp_rest')`). **Required** — without a valid one the route returns 403 before any data is read. The admin UI submits it in a temporary form body so it never appears in a URL.

200.description: The export streams back as a file attachment (`<campaign_id>-archived-campaign-emails-<filter>.csv`); the response is not wrapped in the usual JSON envelope.

401.description: Not authenticated — missing or invalid credentials.

403.description: Invalid or missing `_wpnonce`, or the caller lacks the capability.

422.description: Validation failed — the response message names the offending field.
